# cloudraya_volume (Resource)

A CloudRaya block-storage volume. Supports the full lifecycle: create, read, in-place updates (resize, attach/detach) and destroy.

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "cloudraya_vm_storage_package" "disk" {
  name = "data-disk-15"
}

# A data disk attached to an existing virtual machine. Leave
# virtual_machine_id unset for a detached volume.
resource "cloudraya_volume" "data" {
  name               = "web-01-data"
  region_id          = cloudraya_virtual_machine.web.region_id
  product_id         = data.cloudraya_vm_storage_package.disk.id
  virtual_machine_id = cloudraya_virtual_machine.web.id
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Volume name. CloudRaya exposes no rename endpoint, so changing this forces a new volume.
- `product_id` (String) Storage product (capacity tier). Changing this resizes the volume in place.
- `region_id` (String) Region to create the volume in. Changing this forces a new volume.

### Optional

- `force_destroy` (Boolean) Sent as `force` on destroy. An attached volume is always detached before it is deleted, whatever this is set to. Defaults to `false`.
- `project_id` (String) Project that owns the volume. Defaults to the provider's `project_id`. Changing this forces a new volume.
- `virtual_machine_id` (String) Virtual machine the volume is attached to. Setting, clearing or changing this attaches and detaches in place; leave it unset for a detached volume.

### Read-Only

- `disk_size_gb` (String) Capacity in GB, from the product.
- `id` (String) Volume identifier.
- `status_label` (String) Provisioning status label.
- `updated_at` (String) Last update timestamp.
- `volume_type` (String) ROOTDISK or DATADISK.

## Import

Import is supported using the following syntax:

```shell
# A volume is imported by its ID.
terraform import cloudraya_volume.data <volume_id>
```
